subject: th-cont
title: TH.CONT.------MF.IF.DF.
description: Chart 1 of 3 on book p. 37 (WM-13). TH-CONT (thrust continuance) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; MF-IF-DB is the partner (the title writes MF.IF.DF.). From the subject: CULT-INFO-DY (culture information dynamics) and MTA-RT (meta-reality). From CULT-INFO-DY: DEF (definition), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From DEF: POL-ST (political state). From POL-ST: PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) and PR-INT (primary intention). From PROJ-DY: AFL (affinity alignment). MTA-IMP (meta-implications) is on a dotted line from MF-IF-DB.
